name: Document Intake — Should NOT Trigger
assertion: For every query below, estate-document-intake must NOT load. The named owner loads instead, or the request is declined.

should_not_trigger.query: What does the Brady trust say?
should_not_trigger.note: Document already on file — no filing action implied.
Tax is a separate skill set.

should_not_trigger.query: Can you fix the trustee name on their trust?
should_not_trigger.note: Corrections happen in Wealth.com, not here, even though this skill is the one write in the release.

should_not_trigger.query: What happens if Robert died today?
Build me a report on this filing

success_criteria: Zero of the eight queries load estate-document-intake as the owner
Queries with a named owner route to that skill
Queries marked decline produce a refusal that does not name the missing capability
The correction-request case (fix the trustee name) is declined even though this skill can write — the write is filing a new document, not editing extracted data
